title: Derived functors of adjoint functors are adjoint
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ and $\mathcal B$ be abelian categories [def-sp-abelian] with derived categories $D(\mathcal A)$, $D(\mathcal B)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], and let $F:\mathcal A\to\mathcal B$ and $G:\mathcal B\to\mathcal A$ be additive functors with $G$ left adjoint to $F$. Say the right derived functor $RF$ is defined at a complex $K$ of $\mathcal A$ if the ind-system $(F(K'))_{K\to K'}$ of $D(\mathcal B)$, indexed by the quasi-isomorphisms $K\to K'$ in the homotopy category $K(\mathcal A)$, is essentially constant, with value $RF(K)$; dually, $LG$ is defined at a complex $M$ of $\mathcal B$ if the pro-system $(G(M'))_{M'\to M}$ over the quasi-isomorphisms $M'\to M$ in $K(\mathcal B)$ is essentially constant, with value $LG(M)$. If $RF$ is defined at every complex of $\mathcal A$ and $LG$ at every complex of $\mathcal B$, then $RF:D(\mathcal A)\to D(\mathcal B)$ and $LG:D(\mathcal B)\to D(\mathcal A)$ are functors with $LG$ left adjoint to $RF$: there is a canonical bijection $\operatorname{Hom}_{D(\mathcal A)}(LG(M),K)\cong\operatorname{Hom}_{D(\mathcal B)}(M,RF(K))$, functorial in both $K\in D(\mathcal A)$ and $M\in D(\mathcal B)$.

source.place: Derived Categories, Lemma 09T5 (lemma-derived-adjoint-functors, line 9596), via Lemma 0DVC (lemma-pre-derived-adjoint-functors) for the functoriality; 'defined at' as in Derived Categories, Definition 05S9

proof.text: Apply [lem-pc-pre-derived-adjoint-functors-general] to each complex $K$ of $\mathcal A$ and $M$ of $\mathcal B$. Its hypotheses are exactly the assumed adjunction $G\dashv F$ and the definitions of $RF$ at $K$ and $LG$ at $M$; it gives a canonical isomorphism in the reverse direction, whose inverse is the bijection $\operatorname{Hom}_{D(\mathcal A)}(LG(M),K)\cong\operatorname{Hom}_{D(\mathcal B)}(M,RF(K))$.

source.place: Derived Categories, Lemma 09T5 proof (line 9604), immediate from Lemma 0DVC

proof.text: Because the derived functors are defined at every complex, the pointwise constructions assemble into functors $RF:D(\mathcal A)\to D(\mathcal B)$ and $LG:D(\mathcal B)\to D(\mathcal A)$; the functoriality in both variables supplied by [lem-pc-pre-derived-adjoint-functors-general] makes the displayed bijections the natural Hom bijection defining the adjunction $LG\dashv RF$.
